offline_react_render_check.method: Actual ProjectCommitments and readProjectWork, original untouched public DTO, isolated React hook/effect scheduler, actual React SSR and actual shared UI Button; no DOM/browser/network.
offline_react_render_check.icon_and_css_module_imports: Inert substitutes; no real icon or visual CSS/browser acceptance claimed.
offline_react_render_check.harness_adjustments: Two preceding ad hoc render attempts stopped at dependency loading/real Phosphor icon interop under Node 25; no product file was edited. The final passing render used an inert icon import and the actual shared Button. They are harness attempts, not additional passed product checks.

workspace_integration_read_review.note: Manual review only; no parent workspace runtime or browser render was executed by this auditor.

limitations: These are historical actual synthetic-fixture HTTP/PG/browser DTOs. This audit does not rerun or establish current-candidate domain acceptance, current permissions or present database state.
Commitment current is the retained per-recipient Current pointer; task completed does not prove commitment fulfillment or closure.
Unknown promised_at stays null. recorded_at and created_at are distinct saved fields; neither may be substituted for the other.
The personal-work evidence corroborates queue behavior but must not be passed off as a full project-work response.

Historical project-work GET returns full history without pagination, and historical evidence has no superseded commitment row; synthetic component cases may cover that boundary only if labeled as synthetic.

This auditor did not run the author component test suite, shared typecheck/build or browser. The independent passing render uses an isolated hook scheduler plus inert icon/CSS imports, so it proves historical DTO rendering/state compatibility only, not browser behavior or visual fidelity.
